night_ground_a.png.prompt:
A beautiful seamless tileable top-down game floor texture, orthographic straight-down view, for a charming hand-painted cartoon game set at night outside a Japanese cat village.

Make it genuinely pretty first: a worn earth path of warm ochre and soft sienna curving through lush moonlit grass, a few smooth river pebbles catching a cool silver highlight, two or three fallen maple leaves in muted red and gold, tiny glints of dew. Rich colour, gentle painterly texture, appealing composition with breathing room between the details.

Lighting: soft moonlight from above, cool blue-silver highlights against warm earth tones, gentle ambient occlusion where grass meets stone. Even overall exposure, no harsh cast shadows, no vignette, no visible light source.

Style: hand-painted storybook illustration, flat-ish cartoon colour with soft painterly gradients and delicate darker linework on the stones and leaves, the look of a high quality indie game background.

CRITICAL: it must tile seamlessly in all four directions - the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom. No border, no frame, no vignette, no text, no watermark, no characters, no single large landmark that would obviously repeat.

Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as night_ground_a.png in the current directory and report the path.
